reuse.why: Builds on recurConfigToRSchedule, RSchedule, skipsWeekendOccurrences and applyWeekendRule, the same shared pieces getUpcomingDates and getNextDate use, so the weekend rule is not restated.

duplication.why: Only the small RSchedule setup, the daily-weekend filter expression and the try/captureBreadcrumb wrapper mirror getUpcomingDates; the rule itself is shared.

placement.why: A handler in server/schedules/app.ts next to schedule/get-upcoming-dates, registered and typed in SchedulesHandlers like its neighbours.

scope.why: Adds the handler, its registration and tests, nothing else.

maintainability.why: Short and readable with a comment on the look-around window; config is left untyped and the occurrence-to-day pipeline is a near sibling of getUpcomingDates rather than a shared step.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Weekend decisions go through skipsWeekendOccurrences and applyWeekendRule.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated rule logic; the filter/map pipeline repeats only one-line calls to shared helpers.
